As a Purina Feed Sales Intern, you will be employed by Land O'Lakes, Inc. and placed in a market with participating dealers and cooperatives. You will work alongside local sales representatives, dealer/co-op leaders, and Purina team members to support customer engagement, territory growth, and species-specific nutrition solutions. 
 Interns will be provided with training through Purina Animal Nutrition, and the working location is dependent on those of our dealers.

May – August 2027 (flexible start and end dates)
